nom: Personal Day Even Keel Resurfacing Peel

segments.oily: One reviewer with sensitive/dry-leaning skin suggests this peel would suit oily skin better than her own; another with combination-oily leanings notes it helps regulate oil production and keeps pores clear.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry or dry-leaning skin report the peel does not leave their skin dry or flaky, though one found it too sticky and harsh for dry-leaning sensitive skin.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers say it resolves small flaky patches, is not harsh, and works well within a weekly routine.
segments.sensitive: The great majority of self-described sensitive-skin reviewers report no irritation, redness, or dryness and describe the tingling as mild and reassuring, but a minority experienced burning, stinging, or found it too strong.
segments.mature: Reviewers describing themselves as older or with fine lines report smoother skin and reduced fine lines without dryness, even in a dry climate.

concerns.aging: Reviewers using it for fine lines and sun spots report visible smoothing and diminished lines with continued weekly use.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers say the peel does not dry out or flake their skin, and some contrast it favorably with other peels that left skin scaly; one reviewer with dry-leaning sensitive skin still found it left skin feeling stripped and sticky.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers with sensitive or rosacea-prone skin report no flare-ups or lasting redness after use.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer specifically credits the product with clearing acne without damaging her skin barrier.
concerns.spots: Reviewers report reduced acne scarring, hyperpigmentation, and sun spots with continued use, though one reviewer felt it did not lighten hyperpigmentation as much as hoped.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report fewer active breakouts, shrinking cystic pimples, and clearer pores within days to weeks; a few describe an initial 'purging' phase with more surfaced pimples, and one reviewer had a severe breakout of cystic acne after use.
concerns.oiliness: A small number of reviewers note the peel helps regulate oil production and keeps pores clearer over time.

aspects.libelle: Skin feels soft and smooth after use
Sticky texture, hard to rinse off
Gentle compared to other peels tried
Good value, lasts a long time per bottle

extraits.texte: I'm not sure if it was this product or the spray or both together (my fault for introducing both around the same time I was so excited to try) but my skin was NOT happy. My forehead blew up in breakouts and my cheeks and chin had big cystic pimples. Still recovering a week later after stopping use :( i still have high hopes it wasn't these products but nothing else really changed. Hoping to try again but next time one product at a time!
This reallyyyyy sticks to your skin and feels hard to fully rinse off. I also think it's a bit too strong for my sensitive/dry-leaning skin. Would probably be better for those with oily skin.

I was impressed with this stuff. I have pretty sensitive skin (rosacea, acne) but I use this once a week and haven't had a single flare up. It's a resurfacing peel so of course there's peeling but in a gentler way than most I've used. Others gave me very visibly dry/scaly looking skin under my makeup but this one corrects where it needs it and leaves my skin super soft. I'll definitely buy again.

I've tried enough "gentle" peels to be cynical, but this one earned its keep. The mix of four acids sounds intense, but my sensitive skin handled it without redness or dryness. Ten minutes, rinse, and my skin genuinely looks clearer and smoother. A little goes a long way!
I have sensitive dry skin with blackheads on my nose and chin. This is a good exfoliation peel for once a week. I don't need to use any exfoliating toners with this in my routine.

I am in my mid 30s with frequently clogged pores and blackheads. Not only does using this 1-2 times a week help keep my pores clean, but I've noticed my fine lines diminished as well. Love that it's a multitasker!

I found this product does a great job of making my skin smoother. I have combo skin, but would get little bits of flaky skin here and there. This helps solve that issue and I feel like my skin looks and feels better the next day.
